using FluentAssertions;
using Xunit;

namespace FsusBlog.QualityCorpus;

public sealed class QualityCorpusTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void XunitExactState()
    {
        Assert.Equal(2, Subject.Load());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FluentExactState()
    {
        Subject.Load().Should().Be(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CustomAssertionHelper()
    {
        AssertExpected(Subject.Load());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmptyMaskedBySibling()
    {
        Subject.Load();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TestToTestWrapper()
    {
        ForwarderTarget();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ForwarderTarget()
    {
        Assert.Equal(2, Subject.Load());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1)]
    [InlineData(2)]
    public void StaticParameterizedCases(int expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, Subject.Identity(expected));
    }

    private static void AssertExpected(int actual)
    {
        Assert.Equal(2, actual);
    }
}

internal static class Subject
{
    public static int Load() => 2;

    public static int Identity(int value) => value;
}
